x: Lait, with Archie Bedford in third place, but the visitors had first two in the 440 with Jim Beaumont gaining a point for us. In the 1 mile, Derrick Burfitt and Jack Brown strode round in the lead and never looked like being troubled and they ran in together.

Jim Beaumont kept up the good work by keeping this position and then Gerry Robinson and Gordon Lowers did the two 220 legs. Lowers took us up into 2nd place, but the S.L.H. man came again in the last 10 yards and Gordon was unable to hold him off, and so we finished up third.

In the 600 yards we had Bedford and Jim Beaumont and they had to be content with 4th and 5th positions. The 1,000 yards saw our real strength and here we had the first three home in Derrick Burfitt, Ches Walker and Vernon Blowfield, with Jimmy Wood, of the Poly, 4th.
